elements.requirement: An officer of the Board or the Board may make an assessment in the amount or further amount that ought in their opinion to be charged to make good a loss of tax to the Crown if they discover that an amount of income tax or capital gains tax ought to have been assessed on a taxpayer for a year of assessment but was not, that an assessment has become insufficient, or that an excessive relief was given.
elements.quote: make an assessment in the amount, or the further amount, which ought in his or their opinion to be charged in order to make good to the Crown the loss of tax

elements.requirement: A taxpayer who made and delivered a return under section 8 or 8A for the relevant year of assessment cannot be assessed under subsection (1) if the situation was attributable to an error or mistake regarding the computation basis and the return was made on the basis or in accordance with the practice generally prevailing at the time.
elements.quote: the taxpayer shall not be assessed under that subsection in respect of the year of assessment there mentioned if the return was in fact made on the basis or in accordance with the practice generally prevailing at the time when it was made

elements.requirement: Where a taxpayer has made and delivered a return under section 8 or 8A for the relevant year of assessment, that taxpayer cannot be assessed under subsection (1) for that year and in the same capacity as that return unless one of two specified conditions is fulfilled.
elements.quote: he shall not be assessed under subsection (1) above— (a) in respect of the year of assessment mentioned in that subsection; and (b) ... in the same capacity as that in which he made and delivered the return, unless one of the two conditions mentioned below is fulfilled

elements.requirement: The first condition for making an assessment is that the situation mentioned in subsection (1) was brought about carelessly or deliberately by the taxpayer or a person acting on the taxpayer's behalf.
elements.quote: The first condition is that the situation mentioned in subsection (1) above was brought about carelessly or deliberately by the taxpayer or a person acting on his behalf

elements.requirement: The second condition for making an assessment is that at the time an officer ceased to be entitled to give notice of intention to enquire into the return, or issued a relevant partial closure notice, or issued a final closure notice where no partial closure notice was issued, the officer could not have been reasonably expected on the basis of available information to be aware of the situation mentioned in subsection (1).
elements.quote: the officer could not have been reasonably expected, on the basis of the information made available to him before that time, to be aware of the situation mentioned in subsection (1) above

elements.requirement: Information is made available to an officer of the Board if it is contained in the taxpayer's return under section 8 or 8A for the relevant year of assessment or in accompanying accounts, statements, or documents.
elements.quote: it is contained in the taxpayer’s return under section 8 or 8A of this Act in respect of the relevant year of assessment (the return), or in any accounts, statements or documents accompanying the return

elements.requirement: Information is made available to an officer of the Board if it is contained in any claim made as regards the relevant year of assessment by the taxpayer acting in the same capacity as that in which the return was made, or in accompanying accounts, statements, or documents.
elements.quote: it is contained in any claim made as regards the relevant year of assessment by the taxpayer acting in the same capacity as that in which he made the return, or in any accounts, statements or documents accompanying any such claim

elements.requirement: Information is made available to an officer of the Board if it is contained in documents, accounts, or particulars produced or furnished by the taxpayer to the officer for the purposes of enquiries into the return or claim.
elements.quote: it is contained in any documents, accounts or particulars which, for the purposes of any enquiries into the return or any such claim by an officer of the Board, are produced or furnished by the taxpayer to the officer

elements.requirement: Information is made available to an officer of the Board if its existence and relevance to the situation mentioned in subsection (1) could reasonably be expected to be inferred by an officer from specified return, claim, or enquiry materials, or are notified in writing by the taxpayer to an officer.
elements.quote: it is information the existence of which, and the relevance of which as regards the situation mentioned in subsection (1) above— (i) could reasonably be expected to be inferred by an officer of the Board from information falling within paragraphs (a) to (c) above; or (ii) are notified in writing by the taxpayer to an officer of the Board

elements.requirement: For information disclosure purposes, a reference to the taxpayer's return under section 8 or 8A includes a reference to any of the taxpayer's returns under that section for either of the two immediately preceding chargeable periods.
elements.quote: a reference to any return of his under that section for either of the two immediately preceding chargeable periods

elements.requirement: Where a return is under section 8 and the taxpayer carries on a trade, profession, or business in partnership, a reference to the taxpayer's return includes any partnership return with respect to the partnership for the relevant year of assessment or either of the two immediately preceding chargeable periods.
elements.quote: a reference to any partnership return with respect to the partnership for the relevant year of assessment or either of those periods

elements.requirement: For the purposes of paragraphs (b) to (d) of subsection (6), any reference to the taxpayer includes a reference to a person acting on the taxpayer's behalf.
elements.quote: any reference in paragraphs (b) to (d) to the taxpayer includes a reference to a person acting on his behalf

elements.requirement: The requirement to fulfil one of the two conditions does not apply to income or chargeable gains of the taxpayer for which the taxpayer has been given a notice under section 81(2) of TIOPA 2010 after enquiries into the return have been completed.
elements.quote: The requirement to fulfil one of the two conditions mentioned above does not apply so far as regards any income or chargeable gains of the taxpayer in relation to which the taxpayer has been given, after any enquiries have been completed into the taxpayer's return, a notice under section 81(2) of TIOPA 2010

elements.requirement: An objection to the making of an assessment under section 29 on the ground that neither condition is fulfilled may only be made on an appeal against the assessment.
elements.quote: An objection to the making of an assessment under this section on the ground that neither of the two conditions mentioned above is fulfilled shall not be made otherwise than on an appeal against the assessment

elements.requirement: The relevant year of assessment means the year of assessment mentioned in subsection (1) for cases of unassessed tax or insufficient assessment, and means the year of assessment in respect of which the claim was made for cases of excessive relief.
elements.quote: Any reference in this section to the relevant year of assessment is a reference to— (a) in the case of the situation mentioned in paragraph (a) or (b) of subsection (1) above, the year of assessment mentioned in that subsection; and (b) in the case of the situation mentioned in paragraph (c) of that subsection, the year of assessment in respect of which the claim was made

thresholds.what: the number of statutory conditions of which at least one must be fulfilled to assess a taxpayer who made and delivered a return
thresholds.quote: unless one of the two conditions mentioned below is fulfilled

thresholds.what: the number of immediately preceding chargeable periods whose returns are included in the reference to the taxpayer's return
thresholds.quote: either of the two immediately preceding chargeable periods
